tex_content.html:
Theorem
1. ch3:3.26All pseudo-Euclidean spaces, pseudospheres, and pseudohyperbolic spaces are frame-homogeneous.

In signature $(n,1)$, $(S^{n,1}(R),\bar g_R^{(n,1)})$ is de Sitter space of radius $R$, and $(\mathbb H^{n,1}(R),\bar g_R^{(n,1)})$ is anti-de Sitter space of radius $R$.
